items.label: Size and Material
items.value: S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18. For a relaxed fit, please order one size up. Slight stretch. Double-lined. The milk crinkle fabric is soft, lightweight and breathable. Its textured finish adds a stylish and elegant touch, ensuring all-day comfort

items.label: Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash cold gently with like colors; we recommend using a laundry bag. Do not bleach. Hang to dry or tumble dry on low heat. Vacuum packaging may cause wrinkles. We recommend washing it first for a better wearing effect

items.label: Features
items.value: Cap sleeve, boat neck, solid color, slim fit. Summer tops for women, spring tops, stylish cute tops, summer basic shirts, tank top for women, ruched tops, tops for women trendy, womens tops dressy casual, ladies tops and blouses, business tops, sleeveless tops, easter shirts

items.label: Design
items.value: The slim fit cut and waist ruched design of this basic T-shirt visually elevate the waistline and highlight your curvy beauty, it’s classic, elegant and you'll love it. This cozy tank top is clean, fresh and versatile, making it an essential fashion item for spring and summer

items.label: Occasions and Matching
items.value: This ladies' trendy top is great for casual, resort wear, daily, party, vacation, home, business, school, shopping, travel, beach, etc. Pair it with jeans, skirts and necklaces – effortlessly nail that trendy vibe
